intro.text: A young Elendel gang leader whose crew, rivals of the Cobblers, includes many children of the houseless.

items.text: Before one of Wayne's monthly university visits, Dims asked whether he was a constable that day, gave him his first gum and collected a card debt. Wayne paid extra for a distraction, and Dims, dressed as Wayne, led the gate guards on a chase so Wayne could slip inside.

appearance.text: Wears a bowler hat and bow tie, with his shirtsleeves torn off like the rest of his gang.
